inputs: fixed pilot sample and fixed retry policy

checks.provider_contracts: PASS only if SearXNG searxng-v1 and Marginalia marginalia-v1 are approved, configured and endpoint/auth contracts are recorded
checks.provider_canary: PASS only if each provider returns usable results; rate limit, missing credential, timeout or empty usable set is FAIL
checks.per_provider_arm_capacity: estimate valid rows/query separately for Treatment and Control within each provider
checks.conservative_rate: use the lower one-sided 95% Wilson bound per provider-arm cell, then use the minimum cell rate
checks.sample_attainability: ceil(474 / minimum_cell_rate) <= 1600 and lower-bound expected valid rows per arm >= 474
checks.contamination: pilot exclusions include all V1/V2/V3/V4 and current-pilot duplicates; contamination is counted before acceptance
checks.balance: provider and arm exposure are exactly equal; no adaptive routing or replacement across arm/provider cells
checks.budget: 3200 queries x 2 providers x 2 attempts = 12800 maximum provider calls; preflight must verify quota and time budget
checks.fail_closed: any failed check sets ATTAINABILITY_PREFLIGHT=FAIL and prevents universe freeze

historical_result.searxng: V4 observed positive capacity; conservative pooled floor from V4 Control is 0.31263962236634996 valid rows/query
historical_result.marginalia: WP-1 observed 0 usable results in 10/10 rate-limited requests; no positive capacity demonstrated

decision: FAIL with current repository evidence; a fresh approved, non-rate-limited provider canary and fixed pilot are prerequisites
